description: Source code for Google Test framework's test part handling, including classes and functions for managing test result summaries, printing results, and internal failure reporting helpers.

classes.name: TestPartResult
classes.description: Represents the result of a part of a test, including message, file name, line number, and result type.

classes.name: TestPartResultArray
classes.description: Manages an array of TestPartResult objects, allowing appending and retrieval.

classes.name: HasNewFatalFailureHelper
classes.description: Helper class to detect new fatal failures during test execution.

methods.name: TestPartResult::ExtractSummary
methods.description: Returns a summary of the failure message by omitting the stack trace.

methods.name: operator<<(std::ostream&, const TestPartResult&)
methods.description: Outputs a TestPartResult object to a stream.

methods.name: TestPartResultArray::Append
methods.description: Adds a TestPartResult to the array.

methods.name: TestPartResultArray::GetTestPartResult
methods.description: Retrieves a TestPartResult at a specific index.

methods.name: TestPartResultArray::size
methods.description: Returns the number of TestPartResult objects in the array.

methods.name: HasNewFatalFailureHelper::HasNewFatalFailureHelper
methods.description: Constructor that sets up the helper to monitor for new fatal failures.

methods.name: HasNewFatalFailureHelper::~HasNewFatalFailureHelper
methods.description: Destructor that restores the previous test result reporter.

methods.name: HasNewFatalFailureHelper::ReportTestPartResult
methods.description: Reports a test part result and updates the fatal failure status if needed.
